title: Aeolus sensor catalog
description: Maps raw SMC keys to human-readable labels, scoped by chip family and Mac model. The catalog only decorates: sensor discovery is dynamic, and a machine with no catalog entries at all still shows every sensor it has, unlabelled and fully usable. Validated in CI on every pull request.

key.description: The raw four-character SMC key, e.g. Tp09.

match.description: Restricts this entry to specific hardware. An entry with no match applies everywhere, which should be rare — most keys mean different things on different chips.

chipFamily.description: The marketing chip name a machine is scoped to, e.g. 'M1 Pro'. On Apple Silicon this is machdep.cpu.brand_string with the 'Apple ' prefix stripped (see HardwareIdentity.chipFamily(fromBrandString:)) — write exactly that stripped string, e.g. 'Apple M4 Max' becomes 'M4 Max'. On Intel, machdep.cpu.brand_string is the CPU's own verbose marketing string (e.g. 'Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9880H CPU @ 2.30GHz', with runs of extra internal spaces on some parts) and HardwareIdentity returns it verbatim aside from trimming leading/trailing whitespace — internal spacing is preserved exactly. No normalised Intel convention has been verified against real hardware, so do not transcribe a hardware report's 'Chip or processor' field here — a hand-typed value like 'Intel Core i9-9880H' will never equal the raw brand string and the entry will silently match no Intel Mac. Scope Intel entries with modelIdentifier only until someone confirms the exact brand_string text on real Intel hardware and that convention is documented here.

modelIdentifier.description: Exact hw.model values this entry is scoped to, e.g. 'Mac16,5'. Case-insensitive at match time, but write it as system_profiler or `sysctl hw.model` reports it.

label.description: The human-readable name. Always displayed alongside the raw key, never instead of it.

confidence.description: How much this label should be trusted. Shown in the UI. 'verified' means someone confirmed the mapping against observed behaviour on that hardware; 'guess' is displayed as a guess so a wrong label cannot quietly mislead someone into a bad fan curve.

source.description: Where the mapping came from — an issue number, a pull request, or a citation. Required in practice for 'verified'.
